definitions.full: H3714. kaphis כָּפִיס noun masculine apparently (si vera lectio) technical term for some beam in a house, perhaps rafter, or girder (Late Hebrew id. , Levy, Jastrow, but according to Hoffm ZAW ii. 1881, 71 it is changed from oblong block of wood (O.T.) to a building-stone , or brick in Mishna); — only Hab 2:11 for a stone out of the wall crieth out , ׳וְכ יַעֲנֶנָּה מֵעֵץ and a rafter out of the timber-work answereth it.
